content.short: DendroRithms is a generative art installation inspired by tree growth rings.
content.description: Every Dendro is uniquely generated from user input using an interactive minting process. Buyers collectively decide the rarity and evolution of the artwork. DendroRithms is 100% on-chain. Each Dendro is a one-of-a-kind NFT, eternally stored on the Cardano blockchain. The NFT contains the metadata necessary to regenerate your Dendro as an SVG file. The code will produce the exact same artwork on every run. A unique feature of this project is that the buyers collectively define rarity. At every mint, a buyer can decide to modify their NFT, or not.
content.meta: Find out about DendroRithms (NFT) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
